inputs.shares_source: 12,679,045 common shares outstanding July 31, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026 cover page)
inputs.fcf_source: Trough-to-midcycle owner cash anchor: FY2025 owner cash after sustaining capital ≈ $1.42/sh; base Lawrence path uses $3.50/sh as partial normalization toward $180M mid-cycle owner cash, not 2022 peak OCF $1.48B
inputs.revenue_h1_source: H1 2026 revenue $1,017.8M (10-Q filed 2026-08-07; Q2 YTD Revenues)
inputs.production_source: Metallurgical coal shipped 13.7 million tons in 2025 (10-K FY2025 Item 1)
inputs.reserves_source: 294.5 million tons of reserves at December 31, 2025, including 282.8 million tons proven and probable (10-K FY2025)
inputs.cash_source: Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash $435.8M at June 30, 2026 (10-Q Q2 2026; sec_companyfacts)
inputs.buybacks_source: Payments for repurchase of common stock $1,138.9M FY2025 (10-K FY2025 cash flow statement)
inputs.normalization_note: FY2025 was a trough year: net loss $61.7M, operating cash flow $145M on met coal price weakness. Management repurchased $1.14B of stock while owner cash collapsed. Lawrence base uses trough-to-midcycle normalization ($180M base owner cash), not 2022 peak OCF $1.48B. H1 2026 shows partial recovery (revenue $1.02B, OCF $69M) but remains below mid-cycle.

component_valuation.coverage_statement: Met coal mining operations, net cash, CAPP reserves development option, and explicit cycle reserve — each valued once.

components.label: CAPP met coal mining operations at mid-cycle utilization

valuation.evidence: FY2022-FY2025 operating cash flow $1,484M/$851M/$580M/$145M; FY2025 met coal shipped 13.7M tons; 19 active mines in CAPP (10-K FY2025)

valuation.falsifier: Met coal prices stay below cash cost for four quarters and FY owner cash falls below $100M.

assumptions.label: Mid-cycle normalized owner cash after sustaining capital
assumptions.rationale: Base between FY2025 trough OCF $145M less sustaining capex and partial mid-cycle recovery; low assumes prolonged weak pricing; high assumes partial reversion toward 2024 economics.

assumptions.label: Capital-cycle owner-cash capitalization multiple
assumptions.rationale: Through-cycle multiple on normalized owner cash for a low-cost longwall producer; not peak-margin capitalization.

calculations.label: Equity value of met coal operations

valuation.evidence: Cash $435.8M less long-term debt $3.0M at June 30, 2026 / 12.68M shares (10-Q Q2 2026)

assumptions.label: Operating liquidity retained above distributable net cash
assumptions.rationale: Low case haircuts surplus cash needed for reclamation, working capital, and trough liquidity; base retains operating buffer after $1.14B FY2025 buybacks.

valuation.evidence: 294.5M tons reserves; 282.8M proven and probable (10-K FY2025); option value separate from normalized operating cash
valuation.assumption_summary: Small probability-weighted reserve upside; zero in Lawrence base path.

source.locator: Cover page; 12,679,045 common shares outstanding July 31, 2026

assumptions.label: Probability reserve base supports incremental export tons at mid-cycle margins
assumptions.rationale: Reserve option timing uncertain; base reflects partial realization of undeveloped CAPP tons.

assumptions.label: Gross success value to equity
assumptions.rationale: Incremental NPV of additional longwall capacity at mid-cycle met coal margins; not replacement-cost capitalization.

assumptions.label: Remaining owner-funded development cost
assumptions.rationale: Mining asset capex and pre-production spend before second longwall reaches steady state.

valuation.evidence: FY2025 buybacks $1.14B while OCF $145M; classic peak-to-trough capital cycle risk (10-K FY2025)
valuation.assumption_summary: Deduction for capital returned at unsustainable trough cash flow and cyclical supply response when prices recover.

assumptions.label: Cycle reserve as fraction of price
assumptions.rationale: Low case assumes market embeds unsustainable mid-cycle optimism; base reflects moderate supply-response risk.

valuation.falsifier: Four-quarter average owner cash exceeds $400M while buybacks remain below 50% of owner cash.

option_scan.question: GAAP book misstates core assets?
option_scan.evidence: Coal reserves and mining assets carried at cost less depletion; no land-at-zero pattern (10-K balance sheet)

option_scan.question: Undeveloped reserves / dormant assets?
option_scan.evidence: CAPP reserves development; second longwall not yet at steady-state production (10-K Item 1)

option_scan.question: In-business loss segment?
option_scan.evidence: Single reportable segment; consolidated profitable in Q2 2026 despite FY2025 trough

option_scan.question: Backlog / contracted revenue not in FCF path?
option_scan.evidence: Met coal sold at spot/index-linked prices; no multi-year backlog separate from mining operations

option_scan.question: Private or illiquid stakes below fair value?
option_scan.evidence: No material private equity stakes disclosed

option_scan.question: Transitory distribution / legal recovery?
option_scan.evidence: Regular dividends and buybacks are capital-allocation choices, not litigation recoveries

option_scan.question: Embedded product option in revenue?
option_scan.evidence: Natural gas removed from coal seams is ancillary; CAPP reserves capacity is separate option row

bear.notes: Met coal prices remain weak; CAPP reserves delayed; owner cash stays near FY2025 trough

base.notes: Partial normalization toward mid-cycle owner cash; Q2 2026 rebound informs path but not full run-rate

bull.notes: Met coal price recovery plus CAPP reserves ramp; capital returns accelerate from net cash position

growth_explanation.mechanism: Owner cash grows when seaborne met coal benchmark prices recover and longwall volumes run at full utilization; CAPP reserves adds incremental tons when second longwall reaches steady state
growth_explanation.filing_citation: 10-K FY2025 revenue and OCF tables; Q2 2026 YTD revenue $1.02B (10-Q filed 2026-08-07)
growth_explanation.stress_test: If FY2026 owner cash reverts toward FY2025 $145M OCF, normalized return at $169 stays deeply negative

notes: Proof-first capital_cycle route. Legacy Lawrence IRR is reference; contract authority is decision-grade after refresh.
